name: fivefold_alchemy
title: Fivefold Alchemy
description: A five-part poetic treatise on alchemical operations, detailing the stages of dissolution, purification, and unification leading to the Philosopher's Stone.
text:
I.
The green lion roars in vinegar’s embrace,
Not drowned, but drawn through fire’s patient grace.
White fumes arise—a spectral, milky shroud—
Then blood-red oil, a sun within a cloud.
This secret water, sharp and keen and bright,
Dissolves all matter back to primal light.
Beneath, black coals, the dragon’s sleep profound,
Await the gentle calcining round.

II.
Dissolved, filtered, thickened into gum,
Twelve pounds of earth from earth, a tedious sum.
This gum distills in luted alembic’s trust,
Yielding the oil that turns all base to just.
Airy gold, sol’s tincture, fiery dew—
The last man’s solace, ancient and true.
The phlegm is cast away, the essence kept,
While white fumes promise what the red has swept.

III.
Minium meets vinegar, a tryst of days,
Stirred by wood, avoiding fire’s harsh blaze.
The clear is drawn, then thickened to a tear,
To be distilled in sand, year after year.
Red lion’s blood, our mercury, our guide,
Poured on pure gold’s calx, it will abide.
Or whitened thrice for Luna’s gentle art,
A virgin’s milk to heal the broken heart.

IV.
Grape’s sharpest juice on sericon’s red bed
Makes vitriol, then gum, then spirit dread.
A weak water flows, then white fumes climb,
And *aqua ardens* marks the turning time.
It stinks, it bites, it works without a flame,
Boiling on calx, a self-igniting game.
Dissolve, purify, exalt the earth to salt,
This is the water that will never halt.

V.
The grandest work: thirty pounds of ore
Become green gum, then distilled once more.
White ice congeals in the retort’s cold neck,
Black dragon’s feces, sifted, then a speck
Of fire runs through, to citrine, bright and clear.
Its vinegar extracts the blood held dear.
All liquors mixed, putrefied for fourteen nights,
Then air, then water, then the earth’s deep rights
Are separated, exalted, purified,
Until the four in quintessence reside.
This mercury—no other will suffice—
Is soul and spirit, water, fire, and ice.

**Coda: The Stone’s Ascent**

From black as pitch, the putrefaction’s sign,
Through green’s brief hope, to white as fish-eyes fine,
Then citrine dawn, and finally the red—
The sun restored, all glory overhead.
For Sol and Luna, Sulphur, Mercury,
Are one in the great mystery.
Strike the stone: oil and water flow.
The heavens stretch, the fixed earth, firm and slow.
This is the work: the body, soul, and spark,
Uniting all within the alchemist’s ark.
